query: Turn on automatic Resonance update checks and have the launcher install each new release in the background.
expected_behavior: Offers the explicit opt-in release notice but refuses background or launcher-driven apply
States that the notice is nonblocking, stable-release-only, and stores its setting outside project repositories
Requires a separate reviewed preview followed by apply bound to the exact version, full source commit, profile, and plan digest
Does not send project paths, project data, credentials, or release prose through the notice cache
